## Cohu to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


May 18, 2026


[PDF Version](https://cohu.gcs-web.com/node/19691/pdf)


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 18, 2026-- Cohu, Inc. (NASDAQ: COHU), a global supplier of equipment and services optimizing semiconductor manufacturing yield and productivity, today announced that management will participate at the following investor conferences:


TD Cowen 54th Annual Technology, Media & Telecom Conference
Location: InterContinental New York Barclay, New York, NY
May 27, 2026


23rd Annual Craig-Hallum Institutional Investor Conference
Location: Depot Renaissance Hotel Minneapolis, MN
May 28, 2026


Stifel 2026 Cross Sector Insight Conference
Location: InterContinental Boston, MA
June 2, 2026


2026 Evercore Global TMT Conference
Location: the Omni San Francisco Hotel in San Francisco, CA
June 3, 2026


Portfolio managers and analysts should contact their respective banking representative to schedule a meeting at these conferences.


Presentation materials will be made concurrently available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website,[www.cohu.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cohu.com&esheet=54537625&newsitemid=20260518688544&lan=en-US&anchor=www.cohu.com&index=1&md5=e31d984ddd8cbb5d4d153c36245b1921) .


**About Cohu:**


Cohu (NASDAQ: COHU) was founded in 1947 and is a global technology leader supplying test, automation, inspection & metrology products, software analytics solutions and services to the semiconductor industry. Additional information can be found at[www.cohu.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cohu.com&esheet=54537625&newsitemid=20260518688544&lan=en-US&anchor=www.cohu.com&index=2&md5=240d4e3be9e63b64f97e92695b37b9e7) .


For press releases and other information of interest to investors, please visit Cohu’s website at[www.cohu.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cohu.com&esheet=54537625&newsitemid=20260518688544&lan=en-US&anchor=www.cohu.com&index=3&md5=7a4087e9848c5f806aecf98f2aa3e6e9) .
